mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate reflects a tighter monetary policy stance, compressing equity valuations through increased discount rates and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation signaled by CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeding 0.2% prompts anticipatory monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates an overheating labor market, which typically precedes inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.5% and HOUST monthly growth > 0.5%), the economy approaches its peak, leading to anticipated monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the late-cycle regime condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate reflects a tighter labor market, which typically leads to higher inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 3-month moving average indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to anticipatory monetary easing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS) and robust housing starts (HOUST) indicates rapidly expanding consumer demand, which often precedes inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 2.0% annualized), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the monetary tightening cycle condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
